mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past two months signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5pp, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over the past two months signals strengthening consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances with RSAFS increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals increased economic activity, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases > 100k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decrease by more than 10% and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the past two months, it signals a shift in consumer spending from housing to other sectors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decreases > 10% and RSAFS increases > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST decreases > 10% and RSAFS increases > 1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and GDP (GDPC1) is growing faster than its 12-month moving average, it signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 12mo MA and GDPC1 growth > 12mo MA
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 12mo MA and GDPC1 growth > 12mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
